description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Hardened Bark. When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, that damage is reduced by an amount equal to half your Shifter level. This reduction applies before all other calculations.
  • Dryadic Bond. You gain a darkvision range of 60 feet. If you already possess darkvision, add 60 ft to its range.
  • Additionally, you can form a ranged weapon from plant material as a Bonus Action. As part of an attack, you can automatically form ammunition for this weapon if it requires it. The ammunition disappears are hitting or missing. The weapon remains while it is within 100 feet of you and otherwise disappears. This weapon counts as a natural weapon for you and has a range of 90/360 feet.
  • Defensive Spores. When a creature within 10 feet of you hits or misses you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to force it to make a Constitution Saving Throw against your Spell Save DC. On a failure, the target is Poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the Saving Throw, ending the effect on a success.
